name: snapshot-inventory-ownership
goal: Preserve any pre-existing inventory path when snapshot creation fails.

evidence: Snapshot creation removes its sibling inventory path on any failure, even if that path existed before it.
The existing create method case checks failed-directory cleanup but does not preserve an independently existing sibling file.
At a9b0601e83 the existing create case fails because cleanup deletes its pre-existing sibling inventory.
Commit 4e0d5663ef creates inventories exclusively and cleans only files owned by this snapshot.
Matched red c28c2602573b and green e510d3b693ad keep the same create case and environment.
